design.name: 冻鲛人
design.brief: A pack-hunting frozen merfolk (鲛人) of the North Sea, the drowned sailors' curse: a small hunched fish-man standing on two short webbed legs, a big round fish head with bulging glassy eyes and a wide grumpy mouth, blue-grey scaly skin crusted with frost, ragged fins on the forearms and back, a short fish tail behind, scraps of an old sailor's rope and a tattered sash, a glowing aqua-cyan pearl (鲛珠) set in its forehead (weak spot). Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four webbed fingers; webbed feet with four toes. Twitchy and greedy, dangerous in a pack.
design.weapon: a short jagged ice spear made from a frozen fish bone, lunging
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its two short webbed legs, knees slightly bent, arms held a little away from the body in a relaxed A-pose with both webbed hands open and EMPTY (no spear, nothing held); the big fish head facing straight ahead with the mouth closed, the forehead pearl painted as opaque bright aqua-cyan (no halo); the back and forearm fins as solid shapes; the short fish tail hanging straight down behind
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four webbed fingers, each foot with four webbed toes, clearly countable; the fins and the tail fully inside the frame.
